newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-RANGERS' TETTLETON HAS KNEE SCOPED.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-RANGERS' TETTLETON HAS KNEE SCOPED.

text.p: Texas Rangers designated hitter Mickey Tettleton underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left knee Wednesday and will be sidelined indefinitely, the team said.
Doctors found loose cartilage in the knee and cleaned it out, according to team officials, who said no timetable has been established for Tettleton's return.

Tettleton was injured in a 5-2 win over the Chicago White Sox on April 15 when he stepped on the first base bag awkwardly. An MRI taken on the knee Tuesday determined that arthroscopic surgery was indicated.
Tettleton, a 36-year-old switch-hitter, was batting a dismal .086 (3-for-35) with three homers and four RBI in 10 games this season. He hit .246 with 24 homers and 83 RBI in 143 games last year.
